payment_sign.name: payment_sign
payment_sign.value:
case when "payment"."reverses_payment_id" is null
        then "payment"."amount_cents" >= 0 and "payment"."tip_cents" >= 0 and "payment"."amount_cents" + "payment"."tip_cents" > 0
        else "payment"."amount_cents" <= 0 and "payment"."tip_cents" <= 0 and "payment"."amount_cents" + "payment"."tip_cents" < 0
          and "payment"."reason" is not null and length(trim("payment"."reason")) > 0
      end

purchase_reversal_reason.name: purchase_reversal_reason
purchase_reversal_reason.value: "purchase"."reverses_purchase_id" is null or ("purchase"."reason" is not null and length(trim("purchase"."reason")) > 0)

sale_reversal_reason.name: sale_reversal_reason
sale_reversal_reason.value: "sale"."kind" = 'sale' or ("sale"."reason" is not null and length(trim("sale"."reason")) > 0)
